bodyMarkdown:
## Highlights

- New first-time walkthrough helps you start your first focus loop
- Focus setup now introduces duration, goals, app blocking, and starting a session
- Header and footer walkthroughs explain progress, streaks, goals and main tabs

## Improvements

- Guidance pointers are easier to follow across different phone sizes
- Daily plan editing and onboarding prompts are more reliable

## Why this matters

Introducing 1st time Walkthrough (v4.5.3) is one of those tidy-up releases that does not need a parade, but it still helps the app feel less fussy. Small fixes matter here because CogniFocus is supposed to get out of your way fast. Tap in, start the thing, dodge the scroll spiral, continue your tiny heroic quest. That is the whole deal.

- New first-time walkthrough helps you start your first focus loop gets a little more room to breathe.
- Focus setup now introduces duration, goals, app blocking, and starting a session gets a little more room to breathe.
- Header and footer walkthroughs explain progress, streaks, goals and main tabs gets a little more room to breathe.
- Guidance pointers are easier to follow across different phone sizes gets a little more room to breathe.

So yes, this is a smaller note. The point is still real: fewer weird little moments, clearer feedback, and less friction between you and the session you meant to start. The Goblin may still be dramatic about it, obviously, but the app should feel calmer where it counts.
